exposure: clexane injection for mitral valve replacement
outcome: single fetal demise of twin pregnancy
live male baby delivered without complication
cohort: A patient with a twin pregnancy after ICSI, diagnosed at 32 weeks' gestation with a large subchorionic hematoma, intrauterine growth retardation, and oligohydramnios, who was also on clexane injection for mitral valve replacement.
finding: This case describes the diagnosis and management of a complex twin pregnancy complicated by a large subchorionic hematoma, intrauterine growth retardation, oligohydramnios, and clexane use, resulting in a live birth of one twin after the demise of the other.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed at 34 weeks due to single fetal demise of the twin pregnancy.
